historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for improvements to the playground and a new field house to Martinelli Construction Company at $153,200, the lowest of three bids.

The new Grattan Playground, a full city block built with 1947 recreation bond funds at a cost of $208,000, was dedicated and opened that afternoon, the twenty-second playground dedicated in twelve months.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $186,282 contract with Bauman Landscape, Inc. to rehabilitate the children's play area at Grattan Playground.
